business_problem: Albertsons needed a unified, near-real-time inventory view and better product-quality intelligence so it could automate ordering, improve produce inspections, and keep online and in-store operations aligned.
solution_summary: Albertsons Companies uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Albertsons needed a unified, near-real-time inventory view and better product-quality intelligence so it could automate ordering, improve produce inspections, and keep online and in-store operations aligned. BigQuery unifies inventory, orders, deliveries, and availability data into one source that other systems can trust in near real time, serving as the storage layer. Gemini platform standardizes recipe data and powers AI workflows that support automated ordering and quality control, serving as the serving layer. Vision AI analyzes produce images against Albertsons’ quality standards inside the Intelligent Quality Control system, serving as the compute layer. Gemini extends the AI layer on top of the unified data foundation for analytics and decision support, serving as the compute layer.

Vision AI scores produce on multiple quality dimensions against Albertsons-specific standards
The AI quality program indirectly improves sales by protecting freshness and brand trust
evidence_quotes: Built a single, unified view of all inventory data across stores, distribution centers, and vendor orders with BigQuery.
Albertsons Cos. created an AI-powered Intelligent Quality Control tool using Gemini platform and Vision AI.
BigQuery now serves as a unified source that other systems can rely on.
data_flow: Inventory, vendor, and delivery data is centralized in BigQuery, recipe and ordering logic is standardized through Gemini platform, and Vision AI scores produce quality as items arrive at distribution centers so downstream supply-chain decisions use fresher, cleaner signals.
